source_name: Ian Macleod Distillers official / Wikipedia / Scotch Whisky
key_data: Family-owned (Russell family), HQ Broxburn, founded 1933 by Leonard Russell Snr; Russell family acquired 1963. Distilleries: Glengoyne (2003), Tamdhu (2011), Rosebank (2017), Edinburgh Gin. Brands: Isle of Skye, Smokehead, King Robert, Sheep Dip, Pig's Nose. >15M bottles/yr. Size rank cited inconsistently (10th / 15th / IWSC 7th); '6th largest' NOT confirmed.
48% ABV, 100% sherry oak. Official RRP GBP 499 (retail ~465). Official tasting notes: red fruits/leather/brown sugar; Seville marmalade; spicy liquorice finish.
Glengoyne 24YO White Oak (Oak Masters' debut). 47.8% ABV, first-fill bourbon + virgin oak. Official RRP GBP 375 / US $399.99. UK Jul 2024, US Mar 2025.
46.8% ABV, non-chill filtered, natural colour, American+European oak oloroso. 125th anniversary (2022). Official RRP GBP 139.99.
47.5% ABV, non-chill filtered, no added colour, 100% oloroso (American+European oak). 12,000 bottles/yr. Official RRP GBP 299 / US ~$403. Added to core range May 2025.
Release One, 1990 vintage, bottled 2020. 48.6% ABV. 62% refill sherry butts + 38% refill bourbon hogsheads. 4,350 bottles. Official RRP GBP 1600.
Release Two, 48.1% ABV, refill American oak hogsheads + ex-sherry butts. Launched Aug 2022. Vintage 1990 vs 1991 UNRESOLVED. Official RRP GBP 1800. Outturn N/A.

source_name: Isle of Skye official (isleofskyewhisky.com) + The Whiskey Wash
key_data: All 40% ABV, Talisker-cored blend. 21YO US$114.99 (GBP N/A); 25YO US$179 / GBP 250 (also seen $206.99); 30YO US $321.99 (GBP ~300 approx). 25YO Best Blended Scotch in World SFWSC 2025; 30YO Gold WWA 2026.
